# Gospel of Judas — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Tchacos, pp. 33-58 | Coptic

---

## The Secret Discourse (logos) of Declaration (apophasis) in Which Jesus Spoke with Judas Iscariot

---

**1** The hidden word (logos) of the declaration (apophasis) which Jesus spoke in conversation (shmhe) with Judas Iscariot across eight days, three days before he kept the Passover (Pascha).

**2** When he appeared upon the earth, he performed signs (semeion) and great wonders for the salvation (soteria) of humanity. And some walked in the way of righteousness (dikaiosyne), while others walked in their transgressions (parabasis). The twelve disciples were called.

**3** He began to speak with them concerning the mysteries (mysterion) which are beyond the world (kosmos) and what will happen at the end. Often he would not reveal himself to his disciples, but would be found in their midst as a child.

**4** One day he came to Judaea and found his disciples gathered together and seated in pious observance (eusebeia). When he drew near to them, they were gathered together offering thanksgiving (eucharistia) over the bread. He laughed.

**5** The disciples said to him: "Master (didaskalos), why do you laugh at our prayer of thanksgiving (eucharistia)? We have done what is right."

**6** He answered and said to them: "I am not laughing at you. You are not doing this out of your own will but because it is through this that your god (noute) will be praised."

**7** They said: "Master (didaskalos), you are [...] the Son of our God (noute)."

**8** Jesus said to them: "How do you know me? Truly (amen) I say to you, no generation (genea) of the people (laos) among you will know me."

**9** When the disciples heard this, they began to feel distressed and angry, and began to blaspheme against him in their hearts.

**10** When Jesus saw their lack of understanding, he said to them: "Why has this agitation (tarache) led you to anger? Your god (noute) who is within you — together with his angels (angelos) — your spirits (pneuma) have become aroused against him."

**11** "Let anyone among you who is strong enough among human beings, bring out the perfect (teleios) human and stand before my face."

**12** They all said: "We are strong enough." But their spirits (pneuma) did not dare to stand before him — except Judas Iscariot. He was able to stand before him, but he could not look him in the eye, but turned away his face.

**13** Judas said to him: "I know who you are and from which place (topos) you have come. You have come from the aeon (aion) of Barbelo, which is immortal, and the one who sent you is the one whose name I am not worthy to utter."

**14** Knowing that Judas was thinking about something that was exalted, Jesus said to him: "Come away from the others and I shall tell you the mysteries (mysterion) of the kingdom (basileia). Not that you will go there, but you will grieve much."

**15** When he said this, Judas parted from the others and Jesus led him away.

**16** He said to him: "Lift your eyes up and look at the cloud (nephe) and the light within it and the stars surrounding it. The star that leads the way — that is your star."

**17** Judas lifted his eyes up and saw the luminous (phosteros) cloud, and he entered it. Those who were standing on the ground heard a voice from the cloud (nephe), saying: [...]

**18** Jesus came. He found the disciples sitting together, gathered and debating with each other about this matter, engaged in piety (eusebeia).

**19** They said: "We have seen in a dream (horama) a great house, and in it a great altar (thysiasterion). And there were twelve men — they are the priests (hiereus), we would say — and a name. And there was a crowd of people (laos) waiting around that altar (thysiasterion)."

**20** "And we said: 'Master (didaskalos), allow our priests (hiereus) to offer their offerings.' Jesus said: 'What are you [...] doing?'"

**21** The disciples said: "Some fast for two weeks; some sacrifice their own children; others, their wives, in praise and humility to each other; some sleep with men; some engage in killing; some commit a host of sins and lawless deeds. And the men who stand before that altar invoke your name."

**22** "And in all the works (ergon) of their deficiency (hystere'ma), those sacrifices (thysia) are presented."

**23** When Jesus heard this, he laughed. He said to them: "Why are you stirred up? Truly (amen) I say to you, all the priests (hiereus) who stand before that altar invoke my name. Again I say to you, my name has been written upon [...] of the generations (genea) of the stars through the human generations. And they have planted trees without fruit in my name, in a shameful manner."

**24** Jesus said to them: "Those you have seen receiving the offerings at the altar — that is who you are. That is the god (noute) you serve, and you are those twelve men you have seen. The cattle you have seen brought for sacrifice are the many people you lead astray."

**25** "Before that altar [...] will stand and make use of my name in this way, and the generations of the pious (eusebe) ones will remain steadfast with him. After him another man will stand there from the fornicators (pornos), and another will stand there from the slayers of children, and another from those who sleep with men, and those who abstain, and the rest of the people of pollution and lawlessness and error, and those who say: 'We are like the angels (angelos).' They are the stars that bring everything to its conclusion. For to the human generations it has been said, 'Look, God (noute) has received your sacrifice from the hands of a priest' — that is, a minister of error."

**26** "But it is the Lord (kyrios), the Lord (kyrios) of the universe (pantos), who commands — on the last day they will be put to shame."

**27** Jesus said: "Stop sacrificing [...] which you have [...] over the altar, since they are over your stars and your angels (angelos) and have already come to their conclusion there. So let them be [...] before you and let them go [...] generations. A baker cannot feed all creation under [heaven]."

**28** "And [...] to them [...] as well as the fountain of wisdom (sophia). [...] a generation (genea) [...] light. In imperishability (aphtharsia) [...] since [...] came [...]."

**29** The disciples said: "Master (didaskalos), you have listened to all of this [...] What is the advantage that we have received? What is the advantage that our fathers received, since they departed this life without seeing the aeons (aion)?"

**30** Jesus said — as he laughed — "What are you thinking within yourselves? Why does [...] mourn within you? Your god (noute) who is within you [...] together with [...] your [...] the soul (psyche). [...] Let the strong one among you bring out the perfect (teleios) human and stand before my face."

**31** They all said: "We have the strength." And none of them was able to stand except Judas Iscariot. He was able to stand before him and took his face away from him, turning it aside.

**32** Judas said: "I know who you are and from which place (topos) you have come. You have come from the immortal aeon (aion) of Barbelo, and I am not worthy to utter the name of the one who has sent you."

**33** Knowing that Judas was thinking about something that was exalted and apart, Jesus said to him: "Come away from the others and I shall tell you the mysteries (mysterion) of the kingdom (basileia). It is possible for you to reach it, but you will grieve a great deal."

**34** "For someone else will replace you in order to complete the twelve [disciples] before their god (noute)."

**35** Judas said to him: "When will you tell me these things, and when will the great day of light dawn for the generation (genea) [...]?"

**36** But when he said these things, Jesus left him. And the next morning, after this happened, Jesus revealed himself to his disciples again.

**37** They said to him: "Master (didaskalos), where did you go and what did you do when you left us?"

**38** Jesus said to them: "I went to another great and holy generation (genea)."

**39** His disciples said to him: "Lord (kyrios), what is this great generation (genea) that is superior to us and holier than us, that is not now in these aeons (aion)?"

**40** When Jesus heard this, he laughed and said to them: "Why are you thinking in your hearts about the strong and holy generation (genea)?"

**41** "Truly (amen) I say to you, no one born of this aeon (aion) will see that generation (genea), and no army (stratos) of angels (angelos) of the stars will rule over that generation (genea), and no person of mortal birth can associate with it — because that generation (genea) does not come from [...] which has become [...] the generation (genea) of the people (laos) among [...] the power (dynamis) [...] the other powers (dynameis) [...] by which you rule."

**42** When the disciples heard this, each one of them was troubled in spirit (pneuma). They could say nothing.

**43** Another day Jesus came to them. They said to him: "Master (didaskalos), we have seen you in a vision (horama), for we had great dreams (onar) last night."

**44** He said: "Why have you [...] and why have you gone into hiding?"

**45** They said: "We saw a great house and a great altar (thysiasterion) in it, and twelve men — whom we call the priests (hiereus). And a name and a great crowd of people (laos) was waiting around that altar."

**46** Jesus said: "Truly (amen) I say to you, that multitude crowded around the altar (thysiasterion) and that name — that is your priests (hiereus). [...] and he will stand at the altar (thysiasterion) and use my name in this way, and the generations (genea) of the pious (eusebe) ones will remain loyal to him."

**47** "After him another man will stand there from the fornicators (pornos), and another from those who slay children, and another from those who sleep with men, and those who abstain, and the rest of the people of pollution and lawlessness and error, and those who say: 'We are like the angels (angelos).' They are the stars that bring everything to its end. For it has been said to the human generations, 'See, God (noute) has received your sacrifice from the hands of a priest,' that is, a minister of error."

**48** "But it is the Lord (kyrios), the Lord (kyrios) of the universe (pantos), who will be put to shame on the last day."

**49** Jesus said to them: "Stop your [...]. [...] your god (noute) will not be saved [...] generations (genea) will [...] the archons (archon) [...] But I say to you, [...] the angel (angelos) who [...] the saints (hagios) and the generation (genea) [...] the light."

**50** Now, Jesus said all these things. He took Judas aside privately and said to him:

**51** "Come — and I shall teach you about the things that no person (anthropos) has seen. For there exists a great and limitless aeon (aion), whose extent no generation (genea) of angels (angelos) has seen, in which is the great invisible Spirit (pneuma). No eye of an angel (angelos) has seen it, no thought of the heart has embraced it, and it was never called by any name."

**52** "And a luminous (phosteros) cloud appeared there. And it said, 'Let an angel (angelos) come into being as my attendant.' And a great angel (angelos), the Self-Generated (autogenes) one, the divine light (phos), came out of the cloud. Because of him, another four angels (angelos) came into being from another cloud, and they became the attendants of the angelic (angelikos) Self-Generated one."

**53** "And the Self-Generated (autogenes) one said, 'Let [...] come into being [...],' and it came into being [...]. And he created the first luminary (phosteros) to reign over him. He said, 'Let angels (angelos) come into being and serve him,' and myriads without number came into being. He said, 'Let a luminous (phosteros) aeon (aion) come into being,' and it came into being."

**54** "He created the second luminary (phosteros) to reign over him, together with myriads without number of angels (angelos) to offer service. That is how he created the rest of the aeons (aion) of light (phos). He made them reign over them, and he created for them myriads without number of angels (angelos) for their assistance."

**55** "And Adamas was in the first luminous (phosteros) cloud (nephe) that no angel (angelos) had seen among all those called 'God (noute).' He [...] the image (eikon) [...] and after the likeness of that angel (angelos). He made the incorruptible (aphthartos) generation (genea) of Seth appear, the twelve aeons (aion) of the twelve luminaries (phosteros). And the twenty-four luminaries (phosteros) in their generation (genea) — that is, seventy-two luminaries (phosteros) — in each of the aeons (aion), and their power (dynamis) [...]."

**56** "And Saklas said to his angels (angelos), 'Let us create a human being (anthropos) after the likeness and after the image (eikon).' And they fashioned Adam and his wife Eve, who in the cloud (nephe) is called Zoe (life). For all the generations (genea) seek him by this name, and each calls her by her names. Now Saklas did not [...] give the command except [...] the generations (genea) [...] And the ruler (archon) said to Adam, 'You shall live long with your children.'"

**57** Judas said to Jesus: "[What] is the long duration (chronos) of time that the human being will live?"

**58** Jesus said: "Why do you marvel that the spans of time of Adam and his generation (genea) — which is the number of the limit of the time of Saklas — were fixed? After this, that generation (genea) will be lifted up, and your star will lead the way. Look at the things that you will do. Truly (amen) I say to you, your last days [...] weep [...] the archon (archon) will be destroyed [...] and then the image (eikon) of the great generation (genea) of Adam will be exalted, for prior to heaven, earth, and the angels (angelos), that generation (genea) from the eternal (aionios) realms exists. Look, you have been told everything. Lift your eyes and look at the cloud and the light within it and the stars surrounding it. The star that leads the way — that is your star. Judas lifted his eyes and saw the luminous (phosteros) cloud, and he entered it. Those standing on the ground heard a voice coming from the cloud, saying [...] great generation [...] image [...] And Judas no longer saw Jesus. Immediately there was a disturbance among the Jews. [...] their high priest (archiereus) and they said: 'He has gone into the guest room to pray.' Some scribes (grammateus) were there watching carefully in order to arrest him during the prayer, for they were afraid of the people (laos), since he was regarded by all as a prophet (prophetes). They approached Judas and said to him: 'What are you doing here? Are you a disciple of Jesus?' He answered them as they wished. And Judas received some money and handed him over to them."

---

*Source: Codex Tchacos, pp. 33–58. Coptic. National Geographic Society (2006). Kasser, Meyer, Wurst, eds. Lacunae indicated by [...]. Coptic terms retained in parentheses where relevant.*
